task_description: Write a method in Dafny to sum the length of the names of a given list of names after removing the names that start with a lowercase letter.
specification_response:
Method Signature:
    method SumLengthsOfNames(names: seq<string>) returns (totalLength: int)
Postconditions_prompt:
    - totalLength equals the sum of the lengths of all names in the input sequence that do not start with a lowercase letter
code_response:
Step 1: Determine the method’s signature.
In this case:
    method SumLengthsOfNamesAfterRemovingLowercase(names: seq<string>) returns (totalLength: int)

Step 2: Determine the preconditions.
In this case:
Natural language description:
    - The input is a sequence of strings (names)
Dafny specification:
    requires names != null

Step 3: Determine the postconditions.
In this case:
Natural language description:
    - The total length returned is the sum of lengths of names that do not start with a lowercase letter
- The total length is non-negative

Dafny specification:
    ensures totalLength >= 0
    ensures totalLength == sum of lengths of names in 'names' that do not start with a lowercase letter

Step 4: Write the code, its formal specification, and the verification annotations that help the solver prove the postconditions.
In this case:

```dafny
method SumLengthsOfNamesAfterRemovingLowercase(names: seq<string>) returns (totalLength: int)
    requires names != null
    ensures totalLength >= 0
    ensures totalLength == 
        if |names| == 0 then 0
        else
            // Sum of lengths of names not starting with lowercase
            sum [ |names[i]| | i | 0 <= i < |names| && (names[i])[0] !in 'a'..'z' ]
{
    totalLength := 0;
    var i := 0;
    while i < |names|
        invariant 0 <= i <= |names|
        invariant totalLength >= 0
        invariant totalLength == sum [ |names[j]| | j | 0 <= j < i && (names[j])[0] !in 'a'..'z' ]
    {
        if |names[i]| > 0 && (names[i])[0] !in 'a'..'z' {
            totalLength := totalLength + |names[i]|;
        }
        i := i + 1;
    }
}
```
